edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, creating the privileged role.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, gateable by anyone who front-runs the transfer.
transfernewun is gated by onlyOwner on caller identity.
clearCNDAO is gated by onlyOwner on caller identity.
transfer debits and credits balances using the caller address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall keys allowances and the callback on msg.sender.
clearCNDAO executes the balance-draining transfer operation.
Local _owner in clearCNDAO is taken directly from msg.sender.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends all contract funds to the caller-controlled address.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract through receiveApproval.
The callee of receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall or transfer state.
The to parameter is used as the credit target in transfer.
The tokens parameter is subtracted and added through SafeMath in transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is written as the allowance value in approve.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credit target in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter drives SafeMath sub/add on balances and allowance in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is both allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter sets the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The _newun parameter is the value written by transfernewun.
The _newun parameter flows into the newun state variable controlling transfers.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
The TokenERC20 constructor sets _totalSupply.
The TokenERC20 constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply to compute the reported supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates balances via SafeMath sub/add.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances via SafeMath sub/add.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] via SafeMath sub.
transferFrom both requires to != newun and can set newun = to on the first call.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfernewun overwrites the newun state variable used as a transfer gate.
The SpaceXC payable fallback accumulates the ether later drained by clearCNDAO.
